entities.summary: Ousmane Dieng is a French professional basketball player for the Milwaukee Bucks of the National Basketball Association (NBA). After playing 3 years in France and New Zealand, Dieng was selected in the 2022 NBA draft with the 11th overall pick by the New York Knicks, but was traded to the Thunder on draft night. During the 2024–25 season, Dieng won his first NBA Championship with the Thunder when they won their first title since relocating from Seattle to Oklahoma City.
